name: Change Default Mail Sender Email and Name
author: Ataurr

sections.description:
The Change WordPress Default Email Sender plugin lets you easily change the default WordPress email sender name and email address. By default, WordPress sends emails from wordpress@yourdomain.com with the sender name WordPress. This plugin allows you to set your sender name and email address, ensuring better branding and deliverability of your WordPress-generated emails.

USEFUL LINK

Get a Quick Support

Features

✔ No more using WordPress default mail sender name. Now you can change mail sender name according to your preferences.
✔ Change WordPress default mail sender email address easily with our plugin.
✔ A simple and lightweight plugin that doesn’t bloat your site.
✔ Easy-to-use settings interface within the WordPress dashboard.

Why use this plugin?

This plugin is perfect for users who want to brand their outgoing emails with their own company or website name and email address. It is ideal for those who manage multiple WordPress sites or want a professional appearance for all outgoing communication.

sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload plugin-name.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Settings > Email Sender Settings to configure your sender name and email address.
sections.faq:
How to install this plugin?

Just follow this information
1. Upload plugin-name.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

How to use this plugin?

Install this plugin, go to the wp-admin panel, check the Mail Sender Modifier option on the Settings page, and input your sender name and email.

Will this affect all WordPress-generated emails?

Yes, this plugin will change the sender name and email address for all outgoing emails generated by WordPress.

Can I revert to the default settings?

Yes, you can revert to the default WordPress email sender name and email address by clearing the fields in the plugin settings.

Is this plugin compatible with other email plugins?

This plugin works independently and should be compatible with most email-related plugins. However, if another plugin overrides email sender details, it may take precedence.
